channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-1281 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM)
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-1340 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM)
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-87491 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Google Chromium V8 contains an out of bounds write vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2021-3560 — Red Hat Polkit
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Red Hat Polkit contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability through the bypassing of credential checks for D-Bus requests, allowing for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2026-82078 — PaperCut NG/MF
item.description: Threat Signal 67. PaperCut NG/MF contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate system configuration parameters and execute arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-81578.

item.title: CVE-2026-81578 — PaperCut NG/MF
item.description: Threat Signal 66. PaperCut NG/MF contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify certain system configurations. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-82078.

item.title: CVE-2026-15410 — SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances
item.description: Threat Signal 70. SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a code injection vulnerability which in specific conditions could potentially enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-56290 — Joomlack Page Builder
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Joomlack Page Builder contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via unauthenticated arbitrary file upload.

item.title: CVE-2009-1537 — Microsoft DirectX
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Microsoft DirectX contains a NULL byte overwrite vulnerability in the QuickTime Movie Parser Filter in quartz.dll in DirectShow which could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted QuickTime media file.

item.title: CVE-2026-45498 — Microsoft Defender
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Microsoft Defender contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2025-68645 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a PHP remote file inclusion vulnerability that could allow for remote attackers to craft requests to the /h/rest endpoint to influence internal request dispatching, allowing inclusion of arbitrary files from the WebRoot directory.

item.title: CVE-2025-32463 — Sudo Sudo
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Sudo contains an inclusion of functionality from untrusted control sphere vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow local attacker to leverage sudo’s -R (--chroot) option to run arbitrary commands as root, even if they are not listed in the sudoers file.

item.title: CVE-2025-26633 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Microsoft Windows Management Console (MMC) contains an improper neutralization vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature locally.

item.title: CVE-2018-8639 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Microsoft Windows Win32k contains an improper resource shutdown or release vulnerability that allows for local, authenticated privilege escalation. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run arbitrary code in kernel mode.

item.title: CVE-2022-23227 — NUUO NVRmini2 Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 70. NUUO NVRmini2 devices contain a missing authentication vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload an encrypted TAR archive, which can be abused to add arbitrary users.

item.title: CVE-2024-43451 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Microsoft Windows contains an NTLMv2 hash spoofing vulnerability that could result in disclosing a user's NTLMv2 hash to an attacker via a file open operation. The attacker could then leverage this hash to impersonate that user.

item.title: CVE-2024-8956 — PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI Cameras
item.description: Threat Signal 70. PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI cameras contain an insecure direct object reference (IDOR) vulnerability that allows a remote, attacker to bypass authentication for the /cgi-bin/param.cgi CGI script. If combined with CVE-2024-8957, this can lead to remote code execution as root.

item.title: CVE-2024-8957 — PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI Cameras
item.description: Threat Signal 70. PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI cameras contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a remote, authenticated attacker to escalate privileges to root via a crafted payload with the ntp_addr parameter of the /cgi-bin/param.cgi CGI script.

item.title: CVE-2023-36846 — Juniper Junos OS
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Juniper Junos OS on SRX Series contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to cause limited impact to the file system integrity. With a specific request to user.php that doesn't require authentication, an attacker is able to upload arbitrary files via J-Web, leading to a loss of integrity for a certain part of the file system, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.

item.title: CVE-2022-34713 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A remote code execution vulnerability exists when Microsoft Windows MSDT is called using the URL protocol from a calling application.

item.title: CVE-2018-6065 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an integer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2016-3393 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A remote code execution vulnerability exists due to the way the Windows GDI component handles objects in the memory. An attacker who successfully exploits this vulnerability could take control of the affected system.

item.title: CVE-2014-4148 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A remote code execution vulnerability exists when the Windows kernel-mode driver improperly handles TrueType fonts.

item.title: CVE-2019-18426 — Meta Platforms WhatsApp
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A vulnerability in WhatsApp Desktop when paired with WhatsApp for iPhone allows cross-site scripting and local file reading.

item.title: CVE-2018-8440 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists when Windows improperly handles calls to Advanced Local Procedure Call (ALPC).

item.title: CVE-2019-1322 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows improperly handles authentication requests. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run processes in an elevated context.

item.title: CVE-2016-3309 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when the Windows kernel fails to properly handle objects in memory. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run arbitrary code in kernel mode.

item.title: CVE-2018-8581 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Microsoft Exchange Server. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could attempt to impersonate any other user of the Exchange server.

item.title: CVE-2018-8298 — ChakraCore ChakraCore scripting engine
item.description: Threat Signal 70. The ChakraCore scripting engine contains a type confusion vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-8540 — Microsoft Malware Protection Engine
item.description: Threat Signal 70. The Microsoft Malware Protection Engine running on Microsoft Forefront and Microsoft Defender on Microsoft Windows Server 2008 SP2 and R2 SP1, Windows 7 SP1, Windows 8.1, Windows Server 2012 Gold and R2, Windows RT 8.1, Windows 10 Gold, 1511, 1607, and 1703, and Windows Server 2016, Microsoft Exchange Server 2013 and 2016, does not properly scan a specially crafted file leading to memory corruption. aka "Microsoft Malware Protection Engine Remote Code Execution Vulnerability".

item.title: CVE-2012-1535 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Unspecified vulnerability in Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service via crafted SWF content.

item.title: CVE-2011-1889 — Microsoft Forefront Threat Management Gateway (TMG)
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the Forefront Threat Management Gateway (TMG) Firewall Client Winsock provider that could allow code execution in the security context of the client application.

item.title: CVE-2018-13383 — Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A heap buffer overflow in Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy may cause the SSL VPN web service termination for logged in users.

item.title: CVE-2020-8816 — Pi-hole AdminLTE
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Pi-hole Web v4.3.2 (aka AdminLTE) allows Remote Code Execution by privileged dashboard users via a crafted DHCP static lease.

item.title: CVE-2019-2215 — Android Android Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Android Kernel contains a use-after-free vulnerability in binder.c that allows for privilege escalation from an application to the Linux Kernel. This vulnerability was observed chained with CVE-2020-0041 and CVE-2020-0069 under exploit chain "AbstractEmu."

item.title: CVE-2018-15811 — DotNetNuke (DNN) DotNetNuke (DNN)
item.description: Threat Signal 70. DotNetNuke (DNN) contains an inadequate encryption strength vulnerability resulting from the use of a weak encryption algorithm to protect input parameters.

item.title: CVE-2018-18325 — DotNetNuke (DNN) DotNetNuke (DNN)
item.description: Threat Signal 70. DotNetNuke (DNN) contains an inadequate encryption strength vulnerability resulting from the use of a weak encryption algorithm to protect input parameters. This CVE ID resolves an incomplete patch for CVE-2018-15811.

item.title: CVE-2020-4428 — IBM Data Risk Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 70. IBM Data Risk Manager contains an unspecified vulnerability which could allow a remote, authenticated attacker to execute commands on the system.�

item.title: CVE-2016-0185 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Microsoft Windows Media Center contains a remote code execution vulnerability when Windows Media Center opens a specially crafted Media Center link (.mcl) file that references malicious code.

item.title: CVE-2020-0938 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Microsoft Windows Adobe Font Manager Library contains an unspecified vulnerability when handling specially crafted multi-master fonts (Adobe Type 1 PostScript format) that allows for remote code execution for all systems except Windows 10. For systems running Windows 10, an attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could execute code in an AppContainer sandbox context with limited privileges and capabilities.

item.title: CVE-2019-1215 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Microsoft Windows contains an unspecified vulnerability due to the way ws2ifsl.sys (Winsock) handles objects in memory, allowing for privilege escalation. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute code with elevated privileges.

item.title: CVE-2019-1429 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2020-11652 — SaltStack Salt
item.description: Threat Signal 70. SaltStack Salt contains a path traversal vulnerability in the salt-master process ClearFuncs which allows directory access to authenticated users. Salt users who follow fundamental internet security guidelines and best practices are not affected by this vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2021-20023 — SonicWall SonicWall Email Security
item.description: Threat Signal 70. SonicWall Email Security contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows a post-authenticated attacker to read files on the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20021 and CVE-2021-20022 to achieve privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2026-76461 — Cisco Secure Email Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

item.title: CVE-2026-82329 — JFrog Artifactory
item.description: Threat Signal 69. JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that under default configuration can allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to obtain administrative privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-64849 — MLflow MLflow
item.description: Threat Signal 69. MLflow contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that can allow attackers to reach internal or cloud metadata services and receive response_status and response_body.

item.title: CVE-2026-65400 — Apple macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Apple macOS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker on the network to authenticate to Screen Sharing without valid credentials.

item.title: CVE-2025-62593 — Ray-Project Ray
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Ray-Project Ray contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow remote code execution. Developers using Ray as a development tool may be exposed to this vulnerability exploitable through Firefox and Safari.

item.title: CVE-2026-56164 — Microsoft SharePoint Server
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft SharePoint contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
